source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 January 1926, p. 10 ("Unopposed returns: nominations for the Belfast municipal elections"); Belfast News-Letter, 16 January 1926, p. 7 ("Municipal elections: the new members")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation) together with the triennial election of aldermen for Duncairn, Ormeau, Pottinger, Smithfield, St Anne's, St George's and Woodvale; nominations 5 January, poll Friday 15 January 1926. Ten members were returned unopposed (Belfast News-Letter, 6 and 16 January 1926). In place of the Marquis of Londonderry, who did not seek re-election. Returned unopposed.
